This page lists every DO and ADO file currently retained under `scripts/stata/`. It distinguishes routine operational code from validation and historical material.

Detailed run instructions belong in the Operations and Technical Manuals. The **Dependencies** column lists other BNR DO or ADO files called by the file; it does not list datasets, manifests, dialogs, help files or official Stata commands.

## Current operational code

These files implement the dashboard, tabulation and briefing workflows exposed through **Stata > User > BNR**.

| Area | File | Responsibility | Dependencies |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| ADO utility | [`ado/bnr_workbook.ado`](ado/bnr_workbook.ado) | Creates a standard Excel workbook from a Stata dataset, including data and metadata worksheets. | None |
| ADO utility | [`ado/bnr_yml.ado`](ado/bnr_yml.ado) | Creates standard dataset-metadata YAML from labels, notes, formats, storage types and labelled categories. | None |
| Configuration | [`config/bnr_paths_TEMPLATE.do`](config/bnr_paths_TEMPLATE.do) | Defines the complete workstation path contract, validates the public/private boundary and is copied to the untracked machine-specific `bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`. | Public repository root, separate private companion root and secure REDCap token-file location |
| Menu | [`menu/bnr_menu.do`](menu/bnr_menu.do) | Creates the **User > BNR** dashboard, briefing and table menus and opens the current dialogs. | None |
| Shared CVD configuration | [`common/bnrcvd_globals.do`](common/bnrcvd_globals.do) | Defines shared run metadata and CVD display constants. It deliberately contains no paths or credentials. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` |
| Dashboard Step 1 | [`monthly/bnr_step1_cvd_redcap_extract.do`](monthly/bnr_step1_cvd_redcap_extract.do) | Extracts the selected cumulative CVD REDCap release and writes the private raw CSV, Stata dataset, manifest and log. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` |
| Dashboard Step 2 | [`monthly/bnr_step2_cvd_confidential.do`](monthly/bnr_step2_cvd_confidential.do) | Joins the selected REDCap release to the frozen historical data, harmonises the eras and creates the confidential cumulative CVD dataset and QA outputs. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` |
| Dashboard Step 3 | [`monthly/bnr_step3_metric_inputs.do`](monthly/bnr_step3_metric_inputs.do) | Creates authorised deidentified inputs for counts/incidence, case fatality, length of stay, performance and the combined all-variables product. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` |
| Dashboard Step 4 | [`monthly/bnr_step4_metrics.do`](monthly/bnr_step4_metrics.do) | Controls calculation of the selected metric family and creation of its private unsuppressed staging package. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; `metrics/cvd/bnr_step4_cvd_burden.do`; `common/bnr_step4_stage_metric.do` |
| Metric analysis | [`metrics/cvd/bnr_step4_cvd_burden.do`](metrics/cvd/bnr_step4_cvd_burden.do) | Calculates the current CVD burden metrics, including registered event counts and distributions, and returns the standard long-format data and QA results. | None; receives its contract from Dashboard Step 4 |
| Metric staging | [`common/bnr_step4_stage_metric.do`](common/bnr_step4_stage_metric.do) | Validates and packages unsuppressed metric outputs and QA material in private Step 4 staging. | None |
| Dashboard Step 5 | [`monthly/bnr_step5_review.do`](monthly/bnr_step5_review.do) | Runs the separate Prepare and Approve actions: creates the suppressed review candidate, then records approval of the unchanged reviewed payload and writes the public-ready package, manifest and receipt. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; `common/bnr_step5_suppress.do` |
| Metric disclosure helper | [`common/bnr_step5_suppress.do`](common/bnr_step5_suppress.do) | Applies the metrics disclosure-control rules and creates the candidate and review material used by Step 5. | None |
| Dashboard Step 6 | [`monthly/bnr_step6_publish.do`](monthly/bnr_step6_publish.do) | Verifies the approval and seven-file manifest, promotes approved metrics, creates the ZIP, refreshes the website mirror and registers the download. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` |
| Table Step 1 | [`tables/bnr_step1_cvd_tables.do`](tables/bnr_step1_cvd_tables.do) | Calculates seven private unsuppressed CVD table datasets and QA material from the Step 3 all-variables input. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; user-written `distrate` command |
| Table Step 2A | [`tables/bnr_step2a_cvd_tables.do`](tables/bnr_step2a_cvd_tables.do) | Applies primary and complementary suppression and creates the proposed public datasets, workbook, Markdown, metadata, manifest and disclosure-review material. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` |
| Table Step 2B | [`tables/bnr_step2b_cvd_tables_approve.do`](tables/bnr_step2b_cvd_tables_approve.do) | Validates the reviewed 26-file table payload and records approval without publishing it. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` |
| Table Step 3 | [`tables/bnr_step3_cvd_tables_publish.do`](tables/bnr_step3_cvd_tables_publish.do) | Verifies and publishes the approved table package, release/latest copies, ZIPs, website mirror and download record. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` |
| Briefing Step 1 | [`briefings/bnr_step1_build_briefing.do`](briefings/bnr_step1_build_briefing.do) | Dispatches a routine briefing request to the selected analyst-owned analysis file. It makes no analytical decisions. | One of the three analyst-owned briefing files below |
| Briefing analysis | [`briefings/cvd_incidence/cvd_incidence.do`](briefings/cvd_incidence/cvd_incidence.do) | Calculates annual CVD incidence and rate-ratio outputs and creates a complete private staging package. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; `common/bnrcvd_globals.do`; `common/bnr_stage_briefing.do`; indirectly both ADO utilities |
| Briefing analysis | [`briefings/cvd_case_fatality/cvd_case_fatality.do`](briefings/cvd_case_fatality/cvd_case_fatality.do) | Calculates annual CVD case-fatality outputs and creates a complete private staging package. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; `common/bnrcvd_globals.do`; `common/bnr_stage_briefing.do`; indirectly both ADO utilities |
| Briefing analysis | [`briefings/cvd_length_of_stay/cvd_length_of_stay.do`](briefings/cvd_length_of_stay/cvd_length_of_stay.do) | Calculates annual CVD length-of-stay and bed-demand outputs, including recorded and inferred in-hospital deaths, and writes private date/outlier review checks before creating the staging package. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; `common/bnrcvd_globals.do`; `common/bnr_stage_briefing.do`; indirectly both ADO utilities |
| Briefing staging | [`common/bnr_stage_briefing.do`](common/bnr_stage_briefing.do) | Validates an analyst-owned briefing payload, writes metadata and review material, and creates its workbook and staging package. It does not approve or publish. | `ado/bnr_yml.ado`; `ado/bnr_workbook.ado` |
| Briefing Step 2 | [`briefings/bnr_step2_approve_briefing.do`](briefings/bnr_step2_approve_briefing.do) | Validates the staged package, records the completed human review, and writes the public manifest and approval receipt without publishing. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` |
| Briefing Step 3 | [`briefings/bnr_step3_publish_briefing.do`](briefings/bnr_step3_publish_briefing.do) | Verifies the approval, manifest and file fingerprints; publishes only approved files; creates the ZIP; and refreshes the website mirror. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` |

The untracked `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` is operationally required on each workstation. It is created from the template and must never be committed.

## Validation and controlled tests

These files are not routine release steps.

| Area | File | Responsibility | Dependencies |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Ad-hoc briefing test | [`briefings/ad-hoc/cvd_ad_hoc_workflow_test_2026_v1.do`](briefings/ad-hoc/cvd_ad_hoc_workflow_test_2026_v1.do) | Exercises the ad-hoc branch of the current briefing staging contract. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; `common/bnr_stage_briefing.do`; indirectly both ADO utilities |
| Incidence validation | [`briefings/cvd_incidence/cvd_incidence_equivalence_check.do`](briefings/cvd_incidence/cvd_incidence_equivalence_check.do) | One-time comparison verifying that the migrated incidence analysis reproduces accepted historical results. | None; reads retained comparison products |
| Case-fatality validation | [`briefings/cvd_case_fatality/cvd_case_fatality_equivalence_check.do`](briefings/cvd_case_fatality/cvd_case_fatality_equivalence_check.do) | One-time comparison verifying that the migrated case-fatality analysis reproduces accepted historical results. | None; reads retained comparison products |
| Table validation | [`tables/bnr_step1_cvd_tables_regression.do`](tables/bnr_step1_cvd_tables_regression.do) | Compares Table Step 1 outputs with the accepted historical workbook. | None; reads retained comparison products |

## Historical and retirement material still in the live tree

These files are not part of routine operations and must not be added to the Stata menu.

| Area | File | Responsibility | Dependencies / status |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Historical briefing publisher | [`common/bnr_publish_briefing.do`](common/bnr_publish_briefing.do) | Earlier combined briefing packaging, publication and mirroring route retained only for the historical forensics product. | `ado/bnr_yml.ado`; `ado/bnr_workbook.ado`; `common/mirror_public_to_site.do` |
| Historical mirror helper | [`common/mirror_public_to_site.do`](common/mirror_public_to_site.do) | Copies a historical public briefing package into the former website mirror. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; called by the historical publisher |
| Refit diagnostic | [`refit/bnrcvd-2023-forensics1.do`](refit/bnrcvd-2023-forensics1.do) | One-time comparison of candidate historical stroke datasets; contains historical workstation paths. | None |
| Refit evidence | [`refit/bnrcvd_2023_forensics2.do`](refit/bnrcvd_2023_forensics2.do) | Reproduces the historical process-audit figure about duplication in the CVD file structure. | `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do`; `common/bnrcvd_globals.do`; historical briefing publisher |

The case-count briefing and its migration scripts are not retained in the live tree. CVD event counts are supplied through the dashboard and tabulations pathways.

## Dialogs and help

- Current menu dialogs are stored under `scripts/stata/dialogs/`.
- Current workflow help files are stored under `scripts/stata/help/`.
- ADO help files sit beside their ADO files under `scripts/stata/ado/`.
- Dialogs construct the same commands as direct DO-file use; they do not create a second analytical pathway.

When a DO file is retired, remove its matching dialog and help file in the same cleanup unless another current command still uses them.

## Maintenance rule

Before changing a shared helper, confirm every caller. Keep analytical decisions in analyst-owned files, and keep approval and publication mechanics generic.

After a Stata cleanup or workflow change:

1. search for the retired filenames;
2. open every current menu dialog and help link;
3. run the relevant synthetic or regression checks;
4. run an end-to-end product workflow where practical;
5. run the local-link check and a full Quarto render; and
6. inspect Git status before committing.
